India's factory PMI just hit 56.0, a nine month high.

The HSBC Flash India Manufacturing PMI rose to 56.0 in November from 54.7 in October. A reading above 50 means growth. New orders grew at the fastest pace since June, and factories added staff at the fastest rate in seven months.

More orders means more to plan: raw material to buy, work orders to raise, and invoices to follow up. Check stock below reorder level and dues every week, not just at month end.
